TC-23/S25.title: Dictated audio kept on the device after Save Note and after sign-out
TC-23/S25.detail: Local stack 8b4be94a (round-companion-wt-qa), under runs/.local-stack.lock and the AI tripwire ('no model call'); every ai/* action answered at the Convex socket. rb1-tc23-client.spec.ts -g S25 with rb1-harness.ts (Save Note answered at the socket). 3/7 decided cells pass. After sign-out round-ai-local-audio still holds the dropped take's recording (51 KB) and the landed, unsaved dictation (137 KB + 70-char transcript); the second physician signing in has both rows on the device. 36 h cell needs the aging helper (Manual).

stated.quote: No patient data is stored on the device to support offline use (minimal session cache only, per SOW)
stated.statedPart: no device-held patient audio beyond a minimal session cache
